question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ABSOLUTE
solution:
The correct answer is 'Limited.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word 'Absolute' means **complete; total**. (पूरा, समूचा, संपूर्ण)

 
 
• Example: *I have **absolute** faith in her judgment*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
 
 
• 'Total' means **complete; absolute**. (पूर्ण)
 
 
• Example: *The country has a **total** population of 65 million*.
 
 
 
• 'Limited' means **small or controlled in number, amount, etc**. (संख्‍या, मात्रा आदि की दृष्टि से कम या नियंत्रित, सीमित)
 
 
• Example: *The company's manufacturing capability is quite **limited***.
 
 
 
• 'Complete' means **having or including all parts; with nothing missing**. (संपूर्ण; सर्वांशपूर्ण, सारा)
 
 
• Example: *Pure and **complete** sorrow is as impossible as pure and complete joy*.
 
 
 
• 'Adequate' means **enough for what you need**. (आवश्‍यकता के अनुसार पर्याप्त)
 
 
• Example: *The food was more than **adequate** for the six of us*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The antonyms of the word 'Absolute' are "limited, **restrained, restricted**".
 
• The synonyms of the word 'Absolute' are "complete, total, **unconditional**".
